DOJO

Seishinkai Karate Federation — Kawashimo Branch

[Kawashimo Karate Class, Shiroishi Ward / Seishinkai Kawashimo Branch]
The Kawashimo Karate Class began activities in June 2011 (Heisei 23) at the Higashi-Kawashimo Community Hall.
From February 2021 (Reiwa 3), the venue moved to the circle room at the Coop Sapporo Kawashimo Store.
Since its founding, it has run as a Junior Karate / Parent-Child Karate class, and is active with a wide range of members from preschoolers to adults.
We especially welcome parent-child participants.
While many dojos feel like an extension of school sports-club activities, we aim for karate as health and fitness training — practicing and learning together in a relaxed, club-like atmosphere.
